limitations: Marker counts cannot see lexical antonyms (aumentou/diminuiu) or morphological negation (impossível).
Sentence alignment uses crude stem overlap; heavy restructuring produces review flags, not proof.
Entity detection relies on capitalization and misses lower-case names.

Lost actions are found only when the source verb leaves no stem behind and the candidate keeps only light verbs (predicate_missing); a different content verb is reported, not judged (predicate_replaced).
No deterministic result proves semantic equivalence; only identity does.
